title: 2.8 Trillion Reasons to Worry
description: Kimi K3's weights drop to the public right as Nvidia rallies an industry alliance for open AI security after the Hugging Face hack. Plus: Sam Altman's fear of AI monopolies, a 25-company coalition backing open weights, Ant Group's efficient new Ling-3.0-Flash, and why your building's front door is now a cybersecurity question.
